protocol.captured_pricing: Force eligible backend through saved extreme costs, call backend:auto. This includes automatic transport packing/unpacking/context/promise path even for JS. Explicit JS shortcut is a separate direct control, never a training surrogate.

protocol.selection_accounting: Record first cache miss and cached run separately; reset selector for repeated miss measurements. Overall chosen execution+context+Promise+checksum measured. No timing probes in adaptive selector; policy adaptive only.
protocol.result: Owned Array for every backend/boundary, full-word weighted moduloU32 checksum included. Borrowed Wasm view copied within resident timer.
